item.title: Onepointfour | CHANEL 25 Handbag
item.description: Partizan's Michel Gondry directs Chanel’s latest handbag campaign starring Margot Robbie, reimagining Kylie Minogue’s iconic Come Into My World video, with Kylie making a cameo 24 years later in a full Chanel look.

item.title: Onepointfour | JJerome87, Brush Me Like A Horse
item.description: ProdCo’s Alex Takács directs a new music video for “Brush Me Like A Horse,” the debut solo release from alt-J’s Joe Newman under his new moniker JJerome87. A longtime collaborator of Newman’s, Takács stages the film as a sun-bleached fever dream, somewhere between a Sergio Leone western and a twisted daytime game show. What begins as a surreal western tableau slowly sharpens into something more unsettling.

item.title: Onepointfour | Inspiring Hope Through Tennis
item.description: Directed by Venice Beach-based filmmaker Dane Del Deo, Inspiring Hope Through Tennis explores the legacy of Joseph Oyebog Sr. and the impact of the Oyebog Tennis Academy in Cameroon. The film looks beyond competition and rankings to focus on tennis as a vehicle for access, community, and lasting change. item.title: Onepointfour | ResistDance vs Redaction
item.description: Hungryman director Bryan Buckley reunites with The First Amendment Troop for his second film with the company, capturing their latest protest performance, ResistDance vs Redaction. Staged on April 9 at the Lincoln Memorial and Kennedy Center, the piece responds to renewed scrutiny around the Epstein files and allegations involving Donald Trump. item.title: Onepointfour | Life needs a Biscuit
item.description: Directed by Florian Habicht, Griffin’s Life Needs a Biscuit campaign turns 24 hours in Aotearoa New Zealand into 24 intimate snapshots of everyday life: “one story for every hour of the day, told one biscuit at a time”. Drawing on real people and their own stories, the series brings Habicht’s character-led documentary sensibility into a commercial space, finding warmth, humour and feeling in the small rituals that carry us through the day.
